highlights.headline: Brussels: Rioters clash with police at anti-austerity rally
highlights.summary: Violent rioters, many of whom were masked, confronted police at the edge of an anti-austerity march in Brussels. Police responded with water cannons and tear gas.

items.title: How drones are hunting fires hidden beneath the Cairngorms
items.description: Dramatic flames from the huge Cairngorms wildfire in July have disappeared - but hot spots can continue to burn beneath the earth.

items.title: Schools crisis in France: Investment fails to inspire confidence
items.description: For weeks, schoolchildren in France have been protesting the failing education system. Compared to many other countries, France invests heavily in education but critics say that the funds are not distributed fairly.
